new_jobs.jd: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. As the TradFi PMO at Binance, you will own end\-to\-end delivery of the next phase of our Traditional Finance (TradFi) expansion; a strategic, P0 program extending the firm's offering beyond digital assets. You will drive a portfolio of initiatives spanning new TradFi product lines, new markets and regions, and external data and infrastructure partnerships. You will orchestrate product, engineering, risk, legal, compliance, and finance across multiple workstreams and jurisdictions, keeping a single integrated plan, clear accountability, and executive\-level visibility from roadmap to launch. **Responsibilities** * Own the integrated program plan for the TradFi roadmap, maintaining milestones, critical path, and cross\-workstream dependencies across all initiatives in the portfolio. * Run the PMO operating cadence: weekly workstream reviews, executive steering committees, and crisp status reporting (RAID logs, scorecards, launch readiness) for senior leadership. * Drive market\-expansion workstreams across multiple regions — coordinating regulatory and licensing readiness, localization, and launch sequencing with legal, compliance, and regional teams. * Own the vendor and partner workstream: sourcing, onboarding, and managing the external market\-data and infrastructure partners required for the TradFi stack. * Define launch\-readiness criteria and go/no\-go gates; coordinate phased rollouts and post\-launch retrospectives with product and engineering. * Identify critical\-path risks and blockers early; escalate and drive resolution with workstream owners across product, engineering, risk, legal, and finance. * Maintain a competitive\-intelligence view of the TradFi landscape to inform roadmap prioritization and sequencing. * Standardize PMO tooling and reporting (OKRs, KPIs, dashboards) so program health is visible at a glance across the portfolio. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA, PMP, or CFA preferred. * Project management experience at a broker\-dealer, exchange, fintech, investment bank, or management consultancy, with a track record of delivering trading, market\-data, or brokerage products or large\-scale financial\-services programs. * Solid understanding of TradFi market structure and products across asset classes. * Experience coordinating multi\-jurisdiction launches and working with regulated workflows (licensing, compliance, and partner agreements). * Exceptional executive communication skills — able to synthesize complex, multi\-workstream programs into clear steering materials. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; comfortable making trade\-off calls under ambiguity. * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-velocity, crypto\-native environment. **Preferred Skills:** * Prior experience at a global brokerage or exchange; direct knowledge of the competitive TradFi landscape is a strong plus. * Familiarity with crypto assets, tokenization, and digital\-asset trading. * Working knowledge of regulatory regimes across key global markets. **Why Binance** * Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem * Collaborate with world\-class talent in a user\-centric global organization with a flat structure * Tackle unique, fast\-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment * Thrive in a results\-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning * Competitive salary and company benefits * Work\-from\-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. In Arizona, TSMC is building three fabs, with the first starting 4nm production in 2025, the second by 2028, and the third by the end of the decade. **Job Responsibilities** **Job Description (Responsibility)** **FI/CO Core Modules** * Own the product strategy and roadmap for Financial Accounting (FI) Controlling (CO) capabilities and translate accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, local GAAP) and finance operational requirements into clear product specifications, and drive delivery from concept through launch and iteration. * Ensure data integrity, auditability, and internal\-control requirements (e.g., SOX\-style controls, audit trails, segregation of duties) are designed into the product. **Global Experience** * Design finance products for global deployment: multi\-currency, multi\-ledger/parallel accounting, multi\-entity consolidation, intercompany transactions, and local statutory and tax compliance across regions. * Incorporate country\-specific requirements such as e\-invoicing mandates, withholding tax, and local reporting formats into the roadmap. **AI Capability** * Define and prioritize AI\-powered finance capabilities such as intelligent invoice processing and matching, automated journal entry suggestions, anomaly and fraud detection, cash flow, forecasting, intelligent reconciliation, and natural\-language financial reporting and analysis. * Apply generative AI/LLMs to finance workflows — close checklists, variance commentary, policy Q\&A, and finance self\-service assistants. * Partner with data science and engineering teams to take AI features from experimentation to production, with clear accuracy thresholds, success metrics, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls, appropriate for financial data. **Team Leadership** * Lead, coach, and grow a team of 6–8 product managers/product owners; set goals, review outcomes, and develop talent and succession depth. * Organize the team around clear module ownership and delivery cadences; establish product management best practices — discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmap communication, and data\-informed decision making. * Act as the senior product voice with executives, finance leaders (CFO organization), customers, and partners; align cross\-functional teams (engineering, design, QA, customer success, sales) around a shared roadmap. **Job Qualifications** **Other Requirements** * 10\+ years of professional experience, with significant product management experience in financial software (ERP financials, accounting, treasury, FP\&A) or deep FI/CO experience from SAP or comparable ERP implementation and product work. * Proven experience leading and managing a product team of 6–8 members or more, including hiring, coaching, and performance development. * Deep functional knowledge of FI/CO processes: record\-to\-report, procure\-to\-pay and order\-to\-cash touchpoints, period\-end close, costing, and management reporting. * Demonstrated success delivering products for global markets, including multi\-currency, multi\-entity, and local statutory compliance. * Experience shipping AI/ML\-powered product features, or strong working knowledge of applying AI (including LLMs/generative AI) in enterprise finance products. * Strong understanding of accounting principles (IFRS/GAAP) and finance internal controls; able to converse credibly with controllers, auditors, and CFO stakeholders. * Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills; able to engage from working teams to C\-level. * Fluent English; able to work effectively with global, cross\-cultural teams. * Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred. **TSMC Core Values** At TSMC, We Invite Talented Individuals Who Share Our Vision And Values To Contribute To Our Continued Success. Our Core Values Are The Foundation Of Our Culture, Guiding Every Decision And Action. We Seek Applicants Who Deeply Resonate With These Principles And Embody Them In Their Work * **Integrity:** Tell the truth. We do not brag. We do not make commitments lightly. Once we make a commitment, we devote ourselves completely to meeting that commitment. * **Commitment:** Employees are dedicated to the company, view the company’s success as their own and work diligently to make their best contributions. As commitment is mutual, the Company strives to serve the best interests of its employees. * **Innovation:** Innovation is the wellspring of the Company's growth. It means more than new ideas; it means putting ideas into practice. * **Customer Trust:** We strive to build deep and enduring relationships with our customers, who trust and rely on us to be part of their success over the long term. *(For more details on TSMC’s Core Values, please visit：https://www.tsmc.com/english/aboutTSMC/values)* Fostering a global inclusive workplace reflects TSMC’s core values and business philosophy and is essential for our future success. Our commitment to global inclusive workplace allows us to create an environment where every employee, regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, race, ethnicity, nationality, political affiliation, or sexual orientation, can bring their unique perspective and experiences to work, enabling us to drive profitability, increase productivity, and unleash innovation. We strive to create a workplace that is equitable and accessible to all employees. We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our mission and provide excellent service to our global customers.

new_jobs.title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Investing
new_jobs.jd: **About BJAK** The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile\-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next\-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. ****The Role**** We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release. ****What You'll Own**** * Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services. * Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans. * Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams. * Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys. * Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions. * Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations. * Make trade\-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity. ****What We're Looking For**** * Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role. * Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows. * Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products. * Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post\-launch learning. * Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management. * High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance. * Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high\-growth products is a strong advantage. ****The Kind of Builder We Want**** * Starts from user problems, not feature lists. * Can make decisions with incomplete information. * Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch. * Works well with engineering without hiding behind process. * Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort. ****This Role Is Not For**** * People who only write decks and do not drive execution. * PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering. * Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions. * People who launch features and then stop caring. * PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution. ****Location**** This role is based in **Taiwan** . This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our **Taiwan** office at least 3 days per week. ****Language**** English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. ****Interview Process**** Our process is designed to move fast: * Online assessment or practical task * Role\-specific interview * CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Automation Specialist
new_jobs.jd: ****JOB DESCRIPTION**** ACCOUNTABILITIES \& ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS * Set up, test, and execute automated and dynamic e\-mail campaigns for lead generation and nurturing, trigger\-based campaigns, as well as ad\-hoc emails. This includes building forms and dynamic content. * Define audience and build targeted segmentation for e\-mail campaigns based on sales and engagement. * Responsible for setting up the approval reviews for e\-mail campaigns for suppliers, newsletters, events, brands, and other internal departments, ensuring deadlines are met. Take necessary actions if the deadlines will not be met and find alternative methods to accomplishing goals in the same timeframe. * Implement testing methodologies (A/B testing) within all elements of email marketing to improve engagement and program performance. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with key internal stakeholders, departments and external contacts. * Ensure accuracy, quality, brand consistency and overall customer experience in email communications. * Work closely with in\-house copywriters, translators, and designers to provide guidance on email best practices. **Skills \& Certifications** * Experience building campaigns using Eloqua or similar marketing automation tools desired. * Process\-oriented thinker, motivated team player, resourceful with strong problem\-solving and technical aptitude. * Experience working against tight deadlines in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment keeping a keen eye on detail and accuracy. * Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Local language is a plus. * Proficient in Excel and PowerPoint. * Knowledge of Mac or Microsoft Windows environment. **Marketing Automation Specialist I** * Create segmentation for targeted email audiences. * Process email assets for campaigns. * Set up, test and execute standard email campaigns. * Ensure deadlines are met to ensure emails stay on schedule. * Process and upload qualified leads. **Marketing Automation Specialist II** * Complete understanding of segmentation and how to create targeted audiences on their own. * Set up, test and execute complex email campaigns including dynamic content and nurturing campaigns for a personalized customer experience. * Analyzes results of email campaigns and develops measures of success. Ensures campaigns result in the highest possible levels of engagement to increase conversion. * Identify and implement testing methodologies (A/B testing) within all elements of email marketing to improve engagement and program performance. * Creates email schedules based on capacity and to ensure audience fatigue levels are consistent for optimal performance. * Fosters productive relationships with media partners, internal brand teams and cross\-functional partners. * Provide mentorship to Marketing Automation Specialist I **Requirements** * Requires a Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing field or an equivalent combination of education and marketing experience will be considered in lieu of degree. * 2\+ years of marketing automation in e\-mail usability, deliverability and best practices, including proofing, linking, accuracy, tracking and functionality experience required. For internal candidates, experience can be a combination of internal and external experience. **Marketing Automation Specialist III** * Profound experience in segmentation and building campaigns using Eloqua or similar marketing automation tools. * Sets capacity for optimal use of the customer/subscriber database. * Identifies new media buying and lead generation opportunities. Makes decisions regarding spending levels with the supervision of the Marketing Automation Team Lead/Manager. * Monitor email deliverability for inbox placement analysis. * Strong communication skills and ability to present results/analytics and provide recommendations to various stakeholders as required. * Provide mentorship to Marketing Automation Specialist I \& II. **Requirements** * Requires a Bachelor's Degree in Marketing field –or – an equivalent combination of education and marketing experience will be considered in lieu of degree. * 4\+ years marketing automation in e\-mail usability, deliverability and best practices, including proofing, linking, accuracy, tracking and functionality experience required. For internal candidates, experience can be a combination of internal and external experience. **Senior Marketing Automation Specialist** * Review the work of Marketing Automation Specialists to ensure accuracy, quality, brand consistency and overall customer experience in email communications, goals, and target audience. * Identify opportunities for lead scoring and create models and strategy for use in audience targeting. * Identify and request needed automated programs. * Track, monitor, analyze and report on campaign performance vs. benchmarks. * Trains and mentors other team members * Able to make independent judgements. * Team subject matter expert. **Requirements** * Requires a Bachelor's Degree in Marketing field –or – an equivalent combination of education and marketing experience will be considered in lieu of degree. * 6\+ years marketing automation in e\-mail usability, deliverability and best practices, including proofing, linking, accuracy, tracking and functionality experience required. * Internal candidates: + Experience can be a combination of internal and external experience. + Minimum Highly Effective performance in current role. * Strong identification with Mouser culture and values. ****ABOUT US**** *Mouser Electronics, founded in 1964, is a globally authorized distributor of semiconductors and electronic components for over 1,200 industry\-leading manufacturer brands. We specialize in the rapid introduction of the newest products and technologies targeting the design engineer and buyer communities. Mouser has 28 offices located around the globe. We conduct business in 23 different languages and 34 currencies. Our global distribution centre is equipped with state\-of\-the\-art wireless warehouse management systems that enable us to process orders 24/7, and deliver nearly perfect pick\-and\-ship operations.*
